title: ㄴ 덧나기: 한여름, 무슨 일
objective: Read words like 한여름, 담요 and 무슨 일 aloud with the added ㄴ, and tell when it is not added.
summary: Learn when an extra ㄴ sound is added, as in 한여름 [한녀름].

task.title: Read and write the sounds
task.line: Use the ㄴ rule to choose or write how each word really sounds. An extra ㄴ is added only when the first part ends in a consonant and the next part starts with 이, 야, 여, 요 or 유 (as in 일, 여름, 요). Before other vowels, as in 단어 [다너] or 음악 [으막], no ㄴ is added.

words.meaning: midsummer, the hottest part of summer
blanket (a light one, e.g. on a plane)
words.exampleMeaning: Could I have a blanket, please?
I do housework on the weekend.

letters.as: 여 after a final consonant can sound like 녀 (nyeo).
요 after a final consonant can sound like 뇨 (nyo).

exercises: Write the real sound in [ ]: ① 한여름이에요. ② 담요를 주세요. ③ 무슨 일로 와요?
Choose the sound with the added ㄴ: ① 집안일이에요 — [지바니리에요] / [지반니리에요] ② 무슨 요일 — [무스뇨일] / [무슨뇨일] ③ 좋은 일 — [조으닐] / [조은닐]
Is a ㄴ sound added? Write Yes or No: ① 단어 ② 담요 ③ 음악
Find the word with an added ㄴ and write its real sound: ① 지금 무슨 일을 해요? ② 저녁에 담요를 덮어요. ③ 한여름에 커피를 마셔요.
answers: ① No ([다너]) ② Yes ([담뇨]) ③ No ([으막])
① 무슨 일을 [무슨니를] ② 담요를 [담뇨를] ③ 한여름에 [한녀르메]
